title: Best Gyms in Palmerston North 2026 — Prices & Reviews
meta_desc: Best gyms in Palmerston North 2026. Prices and honest reviews for City Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Les Mills, Snap and student options near Massey.
intro: Palmerston North has a good gym market, boosted by the presence of Massey University and NZDF bases which create a large, active population with real training needs. City Fitness and Les Mills both operate here, giving residents the full range from budget 24/7 to premium group fitness. Student discounts are available at several clubs. If you live in Palmy, you're well-served.

sections.heading: City Fitness Palmerston North
sections.body: City Fitness Palmerston North is the budget leader at $7.99/week — 24/7 access, no long-term contract, full equipment suite. For anyone who just wants to train affordably without committing to a 12-month deal, this is the clear answer. Joining fees are regularly waived. The Black Card ($14.99/week) adds multi-club access if you travel to Auckland, Wellington, or other cities regularly.

sections.heading: Massey University Recreation Centre
sections.body: Massey University students have access to the Massey Recreation Centre on campus, which offers gym, pool, and court facilities at student-discounted rates. The semester membership works out to approximately $10/week — very competitive against commercial alternatives. If you're a Massey student, this is almost certainly your best option, especially with the pool and court access included.

sections.heading: Les Mills Palmerston North
sections.body: Les Mills Palmerston North is the city's premium gym — a full club with the complete LM group fitness timetable. The instructors are good and the equipment standard is strong. At $17.99/week with a 3-month minimum, it's more expensive than City Fitness but the class quality and gym environment are markedly better. The 20% under-23 discount makes it much more competitive for younger members — always ask when signing up.

sections.heading: Anytime Fitness Palmerston North
sections.body: Anytime Fitness has good coverage in Palmerston North. The 24/7 access and reciprocal rights across all NZ Anytime clubs are the main draw. At $16.95/week on a 12-month contract, it's a middle-ground option — more expensive than City Fitness but cheaper than Les Mills. Popular with NZDF personnel and shift workers who need reliable access at non-standard hours.

sections.heading: Jetts and Snap Fitness
sections.body: Jetts offers the best flexibility at $14.95/week with no joining fee and no lock-in — useful for Massey students who don't want a 12-month commitment. Snap Fitness operates at a similar price point with 24/7 access. Both are solid alternatives if you want 24/7 access without committing to a year.

sections.heading: Which Palmerston North Gym Is Right for You?
sections.body: Students: Massey Recreation Centre is the best value, especially with pool access. Non-students wanting the cheapest option: City Fitness at $7.99/week is hard to beat. For group fitness with a full class timetable, Les Mills is the pick. For zero upfront cost and maximum flexibility, Jetts (no joining fee, no lock-in) is the easiest start. For 24/7 access with nationwide club rights, Anytime Fitness is worth the extra cost.

faq.question: What is the cheapest gym in Palmerston North?
faq.answer: For students, Massey University Recreation Centre offers semester rates around $10/week. For non-students, City Fitness Basic is cheapest at $7.99/week with 24/7 access and no lock-in.

faq.question: Is there a Les Mills gym in Palmerston North?
faq.answer: Yes — Les Mills Palmerston North is a full club with group fitness classes. Memberships start at $17.99/week with a 3-month minimum. Under-23 discount of 20% is available.

faq.question: Are there 24/7 gyms in Palmerston North?
faq.answer: Yes — City Fitness, Jetts, Snap Fitness, and Anytime Fitness all offer 24/7 access in Palmerston North.

faq.question: Is there a gym near Massey University Palmerston North?
faq.answer: Yes — Massey University has an on-campus Recreation Centre with student-discounted semester memberships. For students, this is usually the best value option in the city.
